lens: D - Crowdfunding not yet in EU retail
slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Foldable Sofa-Step Dog Ramp
ideas.concept: Foam-core fabric ramp/step that folds into a bench or ottoman, re-designed in Nordic-interior textiles with washable covers; cut-and-sew, no moulds.
ideas.target_customer: Owners of small/senior dogs in Sweden/Denmark with high beds and sofas, urban flats.
ideas.problem_solved: Joint strain from dogs jumping on/off furniture and cars; existing ramps are ugly plastic.
ideas.trend_evidence: SeatMate Split Ottoman Dog Ramp reportedly raised $274,620 vs $10,000 goal (1,310 backers) in 2025 per backerclub/search snippet; I did not independently verify the page or its EU retail absence.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own Scandinavian design language, registered design, modular cover refills; bulky so Amazon private-label less aggressive.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 13-17 (above target band; bulky, test freight cost; may fail landed cost rule)
ideas.tooling_needed: None (cut-and-sew foam and fabric; pattern dies only)

ideas.name: Wicking Planter with Refill Nutrient Inserts
ideas.concept: Passive self-watering ceramic/stoneware balcony planter with a wicking reservoir, sold with subscription refill soil/fertiliser inserts; no sensors or electronics.
ideas.target_customer: Balcony and apartment gardeners and gift buyers in Nordic cities, time-poor plant owners.
ideas.problem_solved: Plants dying while away or overwatered; smart planters need batteries and apps.
ideas.trend_evidence: Self-watering pots drawing major Kickstarter support (HortiDaily headline), BASALAB Caldera planter on PledgeBox, LeafyPod funded (campaign Oct-Dec, likely 2024); signals are for the smart-planter category generally, passive version not verified as underserved.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Exclusive glaze/shape design and proprietary refill insert formulation (REACH-compliant) creates repeat purchase.

ideas.name: Modular Dog Back-Seat Hammock with Anchor Liner
ideas.concept: Quilted, waterproof back-seat hammock with ISOFIX-friendly harness anchor points and removable washable liner, cut to fit common Nordic cars (Volvo, VW, Skoda, Tesla).
ideas.target_customer: Dog owners with outdoor lifestyle in Sweden/Denmark, muddy winters.
ideas.problem_solved: Dirty seats and unsecured dogs; universal hammocks fit poorly.
ideas.trend_evidence: Vomer pet car seat (ISOFIX, 76 backers, ~$21.9k vs goal, spring 2026) shows crowdfunding demand for pet car safety; no verified evidence that textile hammocks are underserved, so this is an adjacent inference.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Model-specific patterns and fitment database as moat; avoid safety/crash-test claims (regulatory risk).

ideas.name: Winter Boot Organiser for Nordic Cars
ideas.concept: Modular felt/Cordura boot organiser with fold-flat dividers and a wet-gear tray for skis, ice scraper, snow brush, dog towels and jump leads.
ideas.target_customer: Car owners in Sweden/Denmark with families and outdoor hobbies.
ideas.problem_solved: Loose gear and wet items rattling in the boot; most organisers are generic and non-seasonal.
ideas.trend_evidence: Car organiser campaigns funded: Settle (EUR 56,062 vs EUR 10,000, 539 backers, 2023), ONWRD (about $12.8k, 2023), Rambl Gear Organizer ($7,493 vs $3,000); none clearly 2025, so trend recency is unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Nordic winter-kit positioning, per-car-model fits and add-on module ecosystem (repeat purchase).

ideas.name: Hand-Operated Garden Weeding Groove Tool
ideas.concept: Forged/stamped steel manual hand tool for creating planting grooves and weeding, with ash or beech handle, sold in a bed-prep kit with seed tape.
ideas.target_customer: Allotment and kitchen-garden owners, gift buyers in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: Fiddly trowel work for sowing rows and pulling weeds without bending.
ideas.trend_evidence: Only weak lead: Garden Groover appealed for Kickstarter help in a forum post archived May 2025; funding outcome not verified. PlantMulti garden multi-tool reported $84,288 vs $10,000 (133 backers) but has electronics.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design and craft-brand story; seed-tape refills add consumable repeat revenue.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stamping die (about EUR 500-1,500), no injection moulds

ideas.name: Ultralight Slim Folding Camp Table
ideas.concept: Roll-up slatted aluminium and webbing camping table in Nordic colours, packing to 40cm, aimed at dog-walking and van weekends.
ideas.target_customer: Hikers, campers and vanlifers in Scandinavia.
ideas.problem_solved: Bulky camp tables; no flat surface in the outdoors for stove or lunch.
ideas.trend_evidence: Ultralight Slim Table campaign found on Kicktraq; Naturehike Snap Chair reportedly $720,064 vs $40,000 in Jan-Feb 2025 and Haven Spectre $566,889 (1,298 backers) show strong outdoor-gear crowdfunding appetite. Naturehike already sells in the EU via other channels, so crowding risk is real; table funding totals not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; relies on design and brand, lookalikes likely from Asian OEMs, so would need a patent or design registration check.
ideas.tooling_needed: Extrusion and cutting jigs, no injection moulds
